# JUDO EPP Common

> JUDO Eclipse Packaging Project (EPP) Common assembles a curated P2 update site of Eclipse features and provides a common OSGi plugin bundle for building JUDO Eclipse-based products.

Key facts:
- Java 21, Maven 3.9.9 with Tycho 4.0.13
- Eclipse/OSGi project using P2 repositories (not Maven Central)
- 3 modules: plugin, feature, and P2 repository site
- Aggregates 100+ Eclipse features (EMF, Sirius, Xtext, JDT, EGit, M2E, DataTools, etc.)
- Targets 5 platforms: Linux x86_64/aarch64, Windows x86_64, macOS x86_64/aarch64
- License: Eclipse Public License 2.0 (EPL-2.0)

## Docs

- [README.md](README.md): Project overview, module descriptions, build commands, and architecture diagrams
- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): Developer guide with build commands, directory structure, and coding conventions
- [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md): Setup instructions and contribution guidelines
- [.github/CIFLOW.md](.github/CIFLOW.md): CI/CD pipeline details, branching strategy, and version numbering

## Modules

- [common/META-INF/MANIFEST.MF](common/META-INF/MANIFEST.MF): OSGi plugin bundle — contains ContributeHandler, splash screens, icons, and branding resources
- [common-feature/feature.xml](common-feature/feature.xml): Eclipse feature — bundles the common plugin with Eclipse Platform, M2E Logback, and M2E PDE
- [common-site/category.xml](common-site/category.xml): P2 update site — aggregates all features into a single installable repository

## Optional

- [pom.xml](pom.xml): Parent POM with P2 repository URLs, Tycho configuration, build profiles, and plugin management
- [.github/workflows/build.yml](.github/workflows/build.yml): CI/CD build pipeline
- [LICENSE.txt](LICENSE.txt): EPL-2.0 license text
